title: Cheon d20 hardened v4: correct scalar-action grids, exact coverage and hard storage

claims.statement: For honest BLS12-381 G1 auxiliary-power inputs with 2^20<=n<=2^32, the deterministic scalar-action Cheon construction recovers the scalar with exact probability m^2/q>=81/200 over uniform nonzero secrets. With C=2000 and W(n)=R(n)/C as defined in argument.md, log2 W(2^20)<134, including preprocessing, failed grids, sorting, routing, verification and output. Peak memory at scoring n is below 2^129 bytes. No walk or production mixing heuristic is used.
